name: cool-mode
title: Cool Mode
description: Sprays coloured particles or emoji from the cursor while a button is pressed, drawn on a click-through canvas.

props.name: children
props.description: The element that sprays particles while it is pressed.

props.name: particle
props.description: 'circle' for dots in the theme's colours, or any short text such as an emoji.

props.name: size
props.description: Particle size in pixels. Leave out for a mix of sizes.

props.name: speed
props.description: Multiplier for how fast particles fly.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Turns the effect off. It is also off on touch devices and under reduced motion.
